'''Imperial Death warrants''' were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperially]] sanctioned death sentences that were acted upon by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Imperial Assassin]]s, and other Imperial agents.

After having been [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|rescued by Galen Marek]], Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis]] cited Imperial death warrants on himself and his family as one of the reasons that convinced him to [[Corellian Treaty|join the Rebellion]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] tried to enact an Imperial death warrant on [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was unable to revoke the warrant issued against [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], but was able to issue a reprieve.

After helping to [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue Han Solo]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] sliced into Jabba's palace computer network to upload false evidence of Imperial death warrants on the late crime lord's chief surviving lieutenants. In response they began to flee the planet en masse, creating a diversion that allowed Artoo, Solo, and the other Rebels to sneak past an Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]].<ref name="Radio">{{RJRadio|Prophecies and Destinies}}</ref>
